gloss: to stir; to rustle; to be in an uproar

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: どよめきませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: どよめいていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: どよめいていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to stir; to rustle; to be in an uproar
definitions.explanation: to become noisy with many voices or sounds, typically from a crowd reacting to something

examples.japanese: {会場|かいじょう}がどよめいた。
{観客|かんきゃく}は{驚|おどろ}きにどよめいた。
{予想外|よそうがい}の{結果|けっか}に{場内|じょうない}がどよめいた。
examples.english: The hall was in an uproar at the unexpected result.

notes:
どよめく describes the collective noise of a crowd reacting to something unexpected or exciting.

VERB TYPE:
- Godan verb (く-verb)
- Intransitive

ETYMOLOGY:
- Related to {響|どよ}む (archaic: to resound)
- Onomatopoeic origin suggesting rumbling/stirring sounds

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {会場|かいじょう}がどよめく (venue stirs)
- {観客|かんきゃく}がどよめく (audience stirs)
- {場内|じょうない}がどよめく (hall is in uproar)
- {驚|おどろ}きにどよめく (stir in surprise)
- {歓声|かんせい}がどよめく (cheers rise up)

USAGE:
- Sports events (unexpected plays, goals)
- Performances (dramatic reveals)
- Announcements (surprising news)
- Public gatherings (reactions to events)
- Implies sudden, collective reaction
- Often written in hiragana
- Usually positive or neutral (excitement/surprise rather than anger)

REGISTER: Literary to neutral. Often used in news reports and novels.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ざわめく (to rustle, murmur) - quieter, more continuous
- ざわつく (to be noisy) - general noise
- {騒|さわ}ぐ (to make noise) - more active/disruptive
